title: order
description: A preorder in which the relation is also antisymmetric — the object generated by adding antisymmetry to a preorder, which settling's leastness supplies. A set with a reflexive, antisymmetric, transitive ≤.

antisymmetric.description: a ≤ b and b ≤ a imply a = b — mutual comparison forces identity, quotienting the preorder's ties
